-- Twilight Witch's Attire (420044) gave only 8 of the set's 15 pieces. It now also holds the seven alternative pieces
-- (shoulders, shirt, chest, waist and three legs), one of each, after the eight it already had (idx 8-14).
-- ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE keeps one row per piece, so a reapply leaves the result unchanged. Like rev_20261024_01 it
-- only acts on a realm that fills the Vanity Store price table.
INSERT INTO `ethereal_bazaar_set_cache` (`cache_item`, `member_item`, `idx`, `count`)
SELECT 420044, `p`.`member_item`, `p`.`idx`, 1
FROM (VALUES
  ROW(420604, 8),   -- Twilight Witch's Mantle (shoulders)
  ROW(420606, 9),   -- Twilight Witch's Halter (shirt)
  ROW(420615, 10),  -- Twilight Witch's Camisole (chest)
  ROW(420605, 11),  -- Twilight Witch's Buckle (waist)
  ROW(420609, 12),  -- Twilight Witch's Shorts (legs)
  ROW(420612, 13),  -- Twilight Witch's Pants (legs)
  ROW(420618, 14)   -- Twilight Witch's Pleated skirt (legs)
) `p` (`member_item`, `idx`)
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `coa_client_vanity_collection` WHERE `BazaarTokenCost` > 0)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `idx` = `p`.`idx`, `count` = 1;

-- The seven Experience Heirloom Caches (1339051-1339057) no longer hold the 3 Heirloom Weapon Tokens (414010);
-- the caches keep their shoulders, chest and two trinkets. Their descriptions stop listing the tokens.
-- A reapply changes nothing (the rows and the line are already gone). Like rev_20261024_01 it only acts on a realm
-- that fills the Vanity Store price table.
DELETE FROM `ethereal_bazaar_set_cache`
WHERE `cache_item` BETWEEN 1339051 AND 1339057 AND `member_item` = 414010  -- Heirloom Weapon Token
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `coa_client_vanity_collection` WHERE `BazaarTokenCost` > 0);

UPDATE `item_template`
SET `description` = REPLACE(`description`, '\nContains x3 Heirloom Weapon Token', '')
WHERE `entry` BETWEEN 1339051 AND 1339057
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `coa_client_vanity_collection` WHERE `BazaarTokenCost` > 0);

-- Tiraxis' Convenience Items (900008) are Realm Bound like the Vanity items next to them: bonding 1 plus
-- ITEM_FLAG_IS_BOUND_TO_ACCOUNT (0x08000000), which the Ascension client shows as "Realm Bound". These seven are not in
-- coa_client_vanity_collection, so the Vanity account-bound change (#9623) does not reach them. A reapply leaves the
-- result unchanged. Like rev_20261024_01 it only acts on a realm that fills the Vanity Store price table.
UPDATE `item_template`
SET `bonding` = 1, `Flags` = `Flags` | 0x08000000
WHERE `entry` IN (
  818047,   -- Potion of Reputation
  200001,   -- Race Change Potion
  910200,   -- Faction Change Potion
  910201,   -- Customization Potion
  1179288,  -- Unlock Talent Loadout
  1806961,  -- Mystic Enchanting: Specialization
  97332     -- Master's Tome Of Specialization (8-20)
)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `coa_client_vanity_collection` WHERE `BazaarTokenCost` > 0);

-- The Heirloom Weapon Token (414010), which the Experience Heirloom Caches hold, is Realm Bound like the heirlooms
-- it buys: bonding 1 plus ITEM_FLAG_IS_BOUND_TO_ACCOUNT (0x08000000), shown as "Realm Bound" by the Ascension client.
-- It was Bind on Use, so an unused token could be traded or auctioned. A reapply leaves the result unchanged.
-- Like rev_20261024_01 it only acts on a realm that fills the Vanity Store price table.
UPDATE `item_template`
SET `bonding` = 1, `Flags` = `Flags` | 0x08000000
WHERE `entry` = 414010  -- Heirloom Weapon Token
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `coa_client_vanity_collection` WHERE `BazaarTokenCost` > 0);

-- COA-6091: Etching of the Dextrous (Runemaster, Agility) stacked with the other classes' Agility buffs such as the
-- Templar's Inquisitor's Edict, because rev_20261009_50 left it out of the shared Agility group 2110001. Add the
-- first rank of its chain (561237 covers 561238-561240) and Greater Etching of the Dextrous 561241.
DELETE FROM `spell_group` WHERE `id` = 2110001 AND `spell_id` IN (561237, 561241);
INSERT INTO `spell_group` (`id`, `spell_id`) VALUES
(2110001, 561237),
(2110001, 561241);

-- Fierce Blow (975011, SPELL_EFFECT_WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE) is cast by many restored Ascension boss
-- kits (rev_20261001_10_boss_kits_scripted.sql and others) but is absent from
-- coa_dungeon_normal_spell_damage, so CoADungeonNormal::TunesSpell() never recognizes it: on Normal
-- it lands raw, with no Normal-rank reduction and no CoA.DungeonNormal.TargetHitCapPct cap, able to
-- one-shot a low-level party (#9297 Aku'mai/Blackfathom Deeps, #9344 Lord Serpentis/Wailing Caverns).
-- 975011 has no own low-level rank with a matching effect structure (975010 "Fierce Blow" is a plain
-- SPELL_EFFECT_WEAPON_DAMAGE rank, not comparable), so this follows the same table's existing pattern
-- for spells without one (normal_spell_id = 0, high = Heroic damage / 1.66 * 0.85, e.g. 15232 Shadow
-- Bolt, 22689 Mangle, 391369 Rend): CoADungeonNormal::Factor() returns `high` unconditionally when
-- normal_spell_id is 0, then the existing single-target 40% max-health cap (TargetCapPct) applies.

DELETE FROM `coa_dungeon_normal_spell_damage` WHERE `spell_id` = 975011;
INSERT INTO `coa_dungeon_normal_spell_damage` (`spell_id`, `normal_spell_id`, `high`, `comment`) VALUES
(975011, 0, 0.512, 'Fierce Blow: Heroic / 1.66 * 0.85, matches Normal dungeon kit softening (#9297, #9344)');

-- Tiraxis' Lost Caches (vendor 900009) cost 250 Bazaar Tokens instead of 100. ItemExtendedCost 2990 charges exactly
-- 250 Bazaar Tokens (975001). The rows are deleted and re-inserted, because npc_vendor's key includes ExtendedCost;
-- a reapply leaves one row per cache at 2990. The Lost Toy and Lost Convenience Caches stay unsold (#8882).
-- Like rev_20261024_01 it only acts on a realm that fills the Vanity Store price table.
DELETE FROM `npc_vendor`
WHERE `entry` = 900009 AND `item` IN (8950001, 8950002, 8950003, 8950004, 8950005, 8950006, 8950008)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `coa_client_vanity_collection` WHERE `BazaarTokenCost` > 0);

INSERT IGNORE INTO `npc_vendor` (`entry`, `slot`, `item`, `maxcount`, `incrtime`, `ExtendedCost`)
SELECT 900009, 0, `c`.`item`, 0, 0, 2990
FROM (VALUES
  ROW(8950001),  -- Lost Weapon Cache
  ROW(8950002),  -- Lost Armor Cache
  ROW(8950003),  -- Lost Mount Cache
  ROW(8950004),  -- Lost Spell Cache
  ROW(8950005),  -- Lost Pet Cache
  ROW(8950006),  -- Lost Beast Cache
  ROW(8950008)   -- Lost Curio Cache
) `c` (`item`)
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `coa_client_vanity_collection` WHERE `BazaarTokenCost` > 0);

-- Hamhock, Targorr the Dread and Bazil Thredd (Heroic): each corpse rolls one Heroic dungeon item, like Dextren
-- Ward (rev_20261022_80; db.exil.es archive, dump of 2026-10-04: every Stockade Heroic boss drops about 889-1013
-- Heroic items at about 0.11 % each).
DELETE FROM `creature_loot_template` WHERE `Entry` IN (101717, 101696, 101716) AND `Item` = 1202039;
INSERT INTO `creature_loot_template` (`Entry`, `Item`, `Reference`, `Chance`, `QuestRequired`, `LootMode`, `GroupId`, `MinCount`, `MaxCount`, `Comment`) VALUES
(101717, 1202039, 1202039, 100, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 'Hamhock (Heroic) - (ReferenceTable) Heroic dungeon item'),
(101696, 1202039, 1202039, 100, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 'Targorr the Dread (Heroic) - (ReferenceTable) Heroic dungeon item'),
(101716, 1202039, 1202039, 100, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 'Bazil Thredd (Heroic) - (ReferenceTable) Heroic dungeon item');

-- Brill loses its CoA class trainers: the 21 posts of rev_20261021_40 were inferred against the vanilla square,
-- but the CoA client rebuilds Brill (patch-WB1.MPQ, Azeroth_31_27.adt) and several stood inside the ruined
-- fountain, the town hall and a fence. No archive gives a real post (AscensionDB, CoA Tavern, the client addons,
-- the SUB world dump and the 2026-07-03 Brill stream show no CoA trainer in Brill), so the spawns and their
-- event 195 links are removed. The trainer templates keep their Undercity and Orgrimmar spawns. Brill's stock
-- trainers are untouched.
--
-- Destiny Weaver Veylin (rev_20260925_30) stood inside the inn wall; she moves outside the inn door, ray-tested
-- 3.0 yd from the wall with open sky above, on the CoA terrain height, facing the square.
DELETE FROM `game_event_creature` WHERE `eventEntry` = 195 AND `guid` BETWEEN 9005000 AND 9005020;
DELETE FROM `creature` WHERE `guid` BETWEEN 9005000 AND 9005020;
UPDATE `creature` SET `position_x` = 2273.25, `position_y` = 257.75, `position_z` = 34.47, `orientation` = 2.04 WHERE `guid` = 9000022 AND `id` = 449353;
